name: Rouge Shop
description: Linglong Chang'an is an assembled model of the scenery of the Tang Dynasty based on Chang'an Street of the Tang Dynasty. Pinku combines elegant tones and meticulous carvings to create an exquisite and exquisite Palm Datang. The sound of reading in the private school, the actors singing vividly on the stage, the sound of gold and silver being thrown in the gambling house...all linger in the streets and alleys. The soothing smell of fireworks and the ordinary people passing by on the street, these small and large things make up the daily life of Chang'an Street.
